<a id="page-media"></a>
# Media (feature layer)

The media layer: video, embedded video, audio, web views, reading text aloud, sounds, printing, screenshots, downloads and preloading images. Open it when a UI plays or embeds media. Its words and actions are allowed only where the host enables the layer (see [levels.md](levels.md)).

<a id="media-words"></a>
## Words

<a id="node-video"></a>
### `Video` (`video`)

`VideoPlayer`. Its changed trigger reports ready/error and, when ready, durationSeconds/positionSeconds without autoplay; with reportIntervalMs, also positionSeconds/playing while it plays.

- Written `Video`. Level 4 (Full vocabulary).
- Takes no quoted string.
- Takes no lines under it.
- Decoration keys (`fill`, `border`, `radius`, `effects`…): only `effects` (blurs).

| Key | Type | Default | Level | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | text | `""` | 4 | A remote HTTPS MP4, WebM, MOV or M4V URL. |
| `autoPlay` | `true`/`false` | `false` | 4 |  |
| `showControls` | `true`/`false` | `true` | 4 |  |
| `playing` | `true`/`false` |  | 4 | Null leaves playback to the built-in controls. Bind or set explicitly to play/pause from application actions; browser gesture rules still apply. |
| `positionSeconds` | number (≥ 0) |  | 4 | Absolute source-media time in seconds; null leaves the current time alone. |
| `volume` | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | `1` | 4 |  |
| `loop` | `true`/`false` | `false` | 4 |  |
| `fit` | `fill` `contain` `cover` `fitWidth` `fitHeight` `none` `scaleDown` | `contain` | 4 | How the picture fills the node (`FittedBox`): `contain` letterboxes, `cover` fills and crops. |
| `poster` | text | `""` | 4 | An image URL shown until the video has its first frame (and while a new source loads), instead of a spinner. |
| `syncTolerance` | number (≥ 0) | `0.3` | 4 | While playing, a changed `positionSeconds` seeks only when the video is more than this many seconds away from it, so a position bound to a running clock corrects drift instead of stalling the video with a seek every frame. Paused, every change seeks (the latest one wins). |
| `reportIntervalMs` | whole number (≥ 0) | `0` | 4 | While playing, fires the changed trigger every this many milliseconds with `positionSeconds` and `playing` (0: off): the video as a clock. |

<a id="media-actions"></a>
## Actions

Written in an event as their type and fields by name, as on [events.md](events.md#events-actions).

<a id="action-print"></a>
### `print`: Print

Requests the platform print dialog for a rendered node. The user chooses the destination and confirms; this action never silently submits a job.

Written `print node=…`. Level 4.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | text | `""` | A rendered node to print through a user-confirmed platform dialog. |

<a id="action-preloadImages"></a>
### `preloadImages`: Preload images

Loads images ahead of showing them (a story's pages before reading), so they draw at once: `urls` is an expression giving a list of URLs (or a comma-separated text). While it runs, `progressVariable` (a variable's name; empty for none) holds the share done (0–1). It waits for every image and gives `{loaded, failed, total}`.

Written `preloadImages urls=… progressVariable=…`. Level 4.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `urls` | text | `""` | The image URLs: a list (an expression) or comma-separated text. |
| `progressVariable` | text | `""` | A variable to hold the share loaded (0-1) while it runs. |

<a id="action-speak"></a>
### `speak`: Speak

Reads `text` aloud, or `stop`s speaking. `rate` and `pitch` are numbers or expressions.

Written `speak text=… language=…`. Level 4.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | text | `""` |  |
| `language` | text | `""` |  |
| `rate` | text | `"1"` | A number or expression. |
| `pitch` | text | `""` | A number or expression. |
| `stop` | `true`/`false` | `false` | Stops speaking. |
| `readAlong` | `true`/`false` | `false` | Times every word (speech.wordIndex) even when the voice reports no word boundaries, and reads along silently without a voice; the action waits until the text is said. |
| `startWord` | text | `""` | Read along: the word to start at (an index or expression), to carry on after a pause. |

<a id="action-playSound"></a>
### `playSound`: Play sound

Plays a synthesised `sound` (a voice name), now or `at` a time on the sound clock, or the sound file at `url`. Every field is an expression.

Written `playSound sound=… operation=…`. Level 4.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sound` | text | `"wood"` | A synthesised voice name. |
| `operation` | text | `"play"` | play, start, stop, or stopAll. |
| `voiceId` | text | `""` | The independently owned sustained voice. |
| `frequency` | text | `"440"` | Sustained tone frequency in hertz. |
| `waveform` | text | `"sine"` | Sustained voice: sine, triangle, square, sawtooth, felt, reed or pluck. |
| `note` | text | `""` | A MIDI note number (60 = middle C) in place of frequency. |
| `duration` | text | `""` | Milliseconds until a started voice releases itself; empty sustains. |
| `volume` | text | `"1"` |  |
| `pitch` | text | `"1"` |  |
| `at` | text | `""` | A time on the sound clock. |
| `url` | text | `""` | A sound file. |

<a id="action-captureScreenshot"></a>
### `captureScreenshot`: Capture screenshot

Captures what is on screen as a PNG image. `${result}` is `{"image": "data:image/png;base64,...", "width", "height"}` (in pixels): bind it to an image fill to show it, or upload it with a `cloudFiles` action whose `source` is `${result.image}`. JSON: `{"type": "captureScreenshot", "target": "app"}`.

Written `captureScreenshot target=… node=…`. Level 4.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | `layout` `node` `app` | `layout` | The screen, one of its nodes, or the whole app (in the host's capture scope). |
| `node` | text | `""` | The node captured (target node). |
| `pixelRatio` | number | `0` | Pixels per logical pixel; 0: the device's. |

<a id="action-downloadFile"></a>
### `downloadFile`: Download file

Exports generated UTF-8 text (CSV, JSON, plain text...) as a file. The browser downloads it; native apps show the platform save picker. Cancellation returns `{saved: false}` as the action result.

Written `downloadFile fileName=… text=…`. Level 4.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fileName` | text | `"export.txt"` | Suggested filename, an expression. |
| `text` | text | `""` | Generated file contents as UTF-8 text. |
| `mimeType` | text | `"text/plain"` |  |
